answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 63 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The zenith register is checked at draw time, ripple lists the eligible set, and pulse seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 63 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone forfeits for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 24 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
